values.description:
A list of values [X1, X2, ...] indicating the valid values for a hyperparameter.
Values can be of type int or float.  Values will be sorted by value to establish order.

title:
Type used to define a ordinal hyperparameter space in a single variable by listing all elements.
(See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statistical_data_type for a description of different statistical data types).
Used by classes extending {@link Hpo.Algorithm}, to specify the hyperparameter search space.
name: Hp.ParamSpace.Ordinal
